subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed report remain the coordination issue for both the delivery-mirror side-branch poison and the empty signed Anthropic thinking replay poison, or should maintainers split it across the narrower open PR/issue paths?
rationale: The remaining work spans separate but interacting transcript-replay paths with active candidate PRs, so choosing the canonical tracking shape and landing order requires maintainer coordination rather than a safe new repair job.

options.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror side-leaf PR and the Anthropic replay-policy PR, then close it only when both failure classes have current-main proof.

options.title: Split Into Canonical Issues
options.body: Move the signed-thinking follow-up to an existing Anthropic replay issue and keep this issue focused on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Wait For Sanitized Fixture
options.body: Ask the reporter for sanitized JSONL and log excerpts before deciding whether the delivery-mirror half still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror side-leaf PR and the Anthropic replay-policy PR, then close it only when both failure classes have current-main proof.
